messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — new cloud marketplace onboarding for CloudForge (partner). Day0 checklist: who owns credentials, legal package, and hero SKU packaging? Need to publish by next Tue. AWS/GCP/Azure all required.

Tom: I can take the legal package + EULA localization. Need contact at CloudForge for SOC/PCI docs. @Priya can you confirm whether we need a trial SKU or seat-based trial?

Priya: Product POV — recommend hero SKU + a 14d 'developer' trial. Pricing tiers: dev (trial), standard, enterprise. Packaging needs 3 screenshots, quickstart, and a short "redwood-verified" blurb. I'll draft the listing copy and screenshot checklist. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Carlos: Engineering questions — who has a tenant to validate the marketplace flow? We need AMI/container images, a manifest, and a test partner account with a service-control IAM role. Suggest we create a staging offer in us-west-2 and europe-west1 for validation.

Jen: I can spin up staging accounts. @Carlos send over the minimal IAM policy you need and I'll attach. Also confirm telemetry/dataflow: we must ensure marketplace doesn't leak PII to partner logs.

marketplace-bot: :information_source: Reminder — Publish checklist items: artifacts, images, legal package, pricing, trial SKU, billing meter IDs, contact emails. Missing: billing meter ID for AWS.

Aisha: Tom, can you confirm legal dependencies for EU localization and VAT handling? Also branding: hero logo versions required (PNG 1024x1024 + SVG).

Tom: EU VAT is handled by finance, but EULAs need localized links. I'll request partner tax ID and SOC docs. Also flag: partner wants wording around "private deployment" — legal prefers we use 'customer-managed deployment' phrasing.

Priya: Packaging note — include an optional section: "Deploy with Redwood Private" but don't gate the trial on it. For Azure we need explicit entitlement mapping for the trial plan — Carlos, can you map plans to meter-ids?

Carlos: I'll map plans to meters. Sharing the staging IAM snippet we'll use for verification:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["ec2:Describe*"], "Resource": "*" } ]
}
```
This is staging-only and read-only by design.

Jen: Got it. I'll create the staging offer with that policy and ping this thread when accounts are ready.

Aisha: Action items recap — Tom -> legal package & partner tax docs; Priya -> listing copy + screenshots + marketing one-liner; Carlos -> meter-id mapping + staging manifests; Jen -> staging accounts & region setup; Aisha -> collect partner assets and timelines. Target: publish prep by Mon EOD, submit to marketplaces Tue morning. :calendar:

Priya: :thumbsup: I'll loop in marketing for the one-liner and coordinate screenshots.

Tom: Note — partner requested permission to use our logo on co-marketing materials; legal needs a signed logo usage form. @Aisha can you request that?

marketplace-bot: :white_check_mark: Checklist status updated. Missing assets: logo usage form, billing meter-id (AWS), trial entitlement mapping (Azure).

Aisha: I'll chase the partner today and update here. If anyone hits a blocker, ping in this thread. Thanks everyone!
